title: IBM MCGA Gate Array Reverse Engineering
summary: IBM MCGA Gate Array Reverse Engineering project performs die analysis and reverse engineering of the IBM Multi-Color Graphics Array chip, documenting its internal architecture and functionality through die photography and circuit analysis.
problem_solved: Restores and documents the undocumented internal structure of IBM's MCGA graphics chip from the late 1980s PC era.
why_valuable: Preserves computing history and provides valuable insights into 1980s PC graphics hardware architecture for retro computing enthusiasts and chip analysis researchers.
